profile_text.body:
Shanghai AI Laboratory is a government-backed research institution focused on artificial intelligence and large language models. According to its website, the laboratory invites global talent to work in areas including artificial intelligence, large models, embodied intelligence, safe and trustworthy AI, AI for Science, foundational platforms, and innovation systems. Since 2022, it has conducted joint doctoral training programs with over a dozen leading Chinese universities including Peking University, Tsinghua University, Fudan University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, Tongji University, University of Science and Technology of China, and Zhejiang University.

The laboratory develops InternLM, a Chinese open-source large language model. Beyond language models, Shanghai AI Laboratory describes its work across multiple technical domains: the Shusheng Duanyan scientific discovery platform that connects scientific large models, professional agents, experimental data, and embodied automation equipment across the full research workflow; the Intern-Robotics embodied full-stack engine for robotics and embodied intelligence; and research into safe and trustworthy AI development through what the laboratory calls an "AI-45° balance law" that seeks to advance both safety and performance in tandem. The laboratory emphasizes risk management across the evaluation, training, foundation, application, and validation stages of AI systems.
